* Convey star Umamusume appearing in chronological order during the race scene.

Faster! Faster... Accelerate!
That's the right choice, I know it! Here goes nooothiiing!!

No... I'm simply trying my utmost to make up for my lack of experience.
...I knew it wouldn't be easy, but coaching really is difficult.

It was as if sparks flew before my eyes.
—Our gazes locked with that much raw force.

!
I just... heard it!

Come on, do it, do it right away, do it right now!
You'll become my Trainer, right?!

See that?!
Told you it'd be fine!
Hold on, I'm coming down to you!

I want to! No, that's definitely what we should do!
The "Voice of Destiny"... is telling me so after all!

—I knew it!
It's you!
A supernova explosion.

Yes, several. However, among them is someone who... how should I put it...
possesses an extraordinary personality...

Turf was violently kicked up into the air. It felt as though an abundance of power
was bursting from her entire body... pure explosive energy.

To nurture the future. That is why I have gradually begun
studying coaching... and received special permission to attend this lecture.

I knew it! I knew it would turn out this way!
Looking forward to working with you, Trainer!

The person who quietly walked in was a Tracen Academy Umamusume. This lecture
was intended for Trainers to learn proper coaching methods, and yet...

It marks the demise of a massive star. Yet that explosion illuminates
the entire universe with blinding light—becoming a cradle that nurtures a thousand new stars.

Yes. It is someone I am coaching—
her name is Epiphaneia.
Hup!

No problem!
Because destiny... is on my side!!

Hmm? Where are you?
No—found it, over here!

Umamusume who refined their speed to an even sharper edge began dominating races
with shocking bursts of acceleration—and are now becoming the new center of the racing world.
Huh?! What about our training...?!

Now then—you!
Become my Trainer!!

—Before I knew it, I was running alongside Cesario.
I didn't know why. But...—
—This way!

—Yes, exactly. My recovery from an injury has taken longer than expected...
So, I thought I would use this time... to prepare for my next dream.

The moment Epiphaneia leaped out... by pure chance, a window blew wide open,
and by chance, a strong gust rushed in... propelling her forward. And then—

After claiming victory as the Japanese Oaks champion, she accomplished the historic feat
of becoming the first Japanese Umamusume ever to win the American Oaks.
Ah—

—I will not be swayed by mere momentum.
Our destinies did not intertwine.
Ah! Wait, there are obstacles down below...!
Woooaaahhhhh!!!!

Ah, not again...!
And after I specifically told her to wait...

—Ah! I found her!
Up there, on the second floor...!

Umamusume with unimaginable closing speed arrived on the scene. Many who looked
up to them followed suit, and intense contests of pure speed became the norm.

However, there is not just a single star. Stars that shine with supreme brilliance on their own courses,
stars whose light reaches across the seas... countless luminaries sparkle in the night sky.

What kind of explosion that extraordinarily brilliant star will bring about—
even the universe itself does not know.

In this universe, too, a tremendous supernova explosion once occurred.
That explosion was so immensely powerful—it transformed racing itself.

As a rookie Trainer, there was an endless amount to learn for the sake of the Umamusume.
To grow, I came to attend a special lecture hosted by the URA. When suddenly—
—Everything seemed to move in slow motion.
